services.name: event yachts
services.desc: A 35-foot classic trawler from Taiwan's CHB yard, finished in varnished teak inside and out - the kind of woodwork production boats stopped carrying decades ago. The flybridge seats the whole party in open air; below, a warm salon with oversized windows and a galley with refrigeration keeps the group comfortable in any season. Her displacement hull rides Bay chop with the settled, unhurried motion trawlers are loved for, which makes her the fleet's year-round boat: golden-hour cruises, waterfront events from the water, quiet ceremonies handled with care.
